lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots are arranged in roughly vertical columns posterior to the gill slits. A distinct column of four larger spots is visible followed by a grid-like pattern extending posteriorly along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible, intersecting with horizontal rows of spots to form a characteristic grid pattern in the area behind the pectoral fin attachment.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A sharp horizontal ridge is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a distinct luminance gradient with highlights on the upper edge and a shadow line directly below.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high density of small, high-intensity spots across its visible surface, particularly concentrated along the leading edge.
